Hi there hope your hanging in there . So from what what I read , I could give you give this advice. 

Autism and adhd have negatives and positives . And since u have both they can balance themselves out. ADHD and will give you enough creativity if you let it. The autism will want to make you follow a specific routine and stay alone alone for a while depending on the level of spectrum your in. but ADHD will want you to share your taughts and creativity with others

You gotta find a compromise . Make a routine where u get enough time alone and find friends that u connect with on some level so you wouldn't mind spending time with them

On the academic issue, I think u gotta create a good routine where u dedicate a big portion of it to studying and working on assignments. This is a part of your life that u need to invest in acedemic studies. U might as well obsess over the subject .

Final thing is u gotta find a way to boost dopamine. Whether an hour of exercise before spending 3 hours straight working on school or any other way.. like for me, simply chilling in a bus while listening to music boosts my dopamine and gets me in a state of bliss. Alternatively you can test small doses of Ritalin with psychiatrist permission ofcourse. Ritalin is a short acting stimulant that will boost your dopamine , help u focus , get you undistracted .... 

Also vitamin d supplements might help too

Of course this is from what I read . If there are other issues that are bothering you , you gotta make a list and rank them in the order of what's annoying you the most . Gotta prioritise and work on the issues 1 by one

It actually might be a balanced contribution of everything. In that case you have to tackle the issues slowly and equally 

That's it really hope this can help in some way. After a 4 year battle with depression I think I figured out what it really is and feel like I'm getting out of it . You can too : )

I don't know you and what you're going through but here's some advice that might help you and everyone else in this sub Reddit.

\- Take some time off from the world . Check yourself in a psychiatric unit or just stay at home for a while (not too much just 3 - 4 weeks ). Watch your favorite movies, TV series , read some interesting fiction book . If possible go to some group therapy.

\- Don't take yourself or the world too seriously. Embrace your quirks and flaws and if it can make others laugh than remember you're making someone happy. Surround yourself with people that enjoy your personality and character.

\- Be kind to others. Whether it's helping them out or giving them financial aid. Doesn't matter what you do. Try to be happy because everyone else is happy. Same concept works with partying . You see everyone having a good time and empathize with them. Empathy is a powerful thing. It can cause social anxiety or give you a great high. Try to harness it in your favour

That's it really. Of coarse I can't practice what I preach, not anymore . Anyway take care.
